ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Exhibitor sales, Qualified and later stages need Stand size (sqm) and Next step date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Exhibitor_sales", CASE(StageName, "Enquiry", 1, "Qualified", 2, "Space held", 3, "Contract sent", 4, "Confirmed", 5, 0) >= 2, OR(ISBLANK(Stand_size_sqm__c), ISBLANK(Next_step_date__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Stand size (sqm) and Next step date before moving to Qualified.
